summary: This bill amends the HITECH Act to generally prohibit healthcare providers from charging individuals for copies of their protected health information, with exceptions for duplicate requests within the same year or non-electronic copies when an electronic version is available online for free.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts healthcare by making it easier and cheaper for individuals to access their protected health information. By reducing fees for medical records, it aims to improve patient access and control over their health data, which is a core aspect of healthcare delivery and patient rights.
